scanNote:
12-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (82-bet).

Yuqorida chapda oq 'UNIT 12'. Uchta surat: A - mehmonxona qabulxonasi, eski jomadonlar uyumidan yasalgan stol oldida oila; B - restoran kirishi (Secret Garden Restaurant, haykal, gulli yo'lak); C - shiftga qadar cho'zilgan 'uchuvchi mashina' (flying machine), atrofida bolalar.
Katta ko'k sarlavha 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) Qiya: 'The Alton Towers Hotel is a famous hotel in England.' 'Look at the pictures. Which shows: a flying machine ☐; a reception desk made of piles of antique luggage ☐; themed rooms and suites ☐; a luxurious restaurant ☐?'
2) 'Circle the correct answers.' 1 A GUEST is someone who ... a works at a hotel. b is staying at a hotel. 2 When you BOOK a hotel room ... a you pay for it. b you reserve it. 3 A BABY-LISTENING FACILITY ... a helps you listen to your baby while it is sleeping in another room. b looks after your baby while you are swimming.
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and tick what you can find at the Alton Towers Hotel.' a a gym b a reception desk c themed rooms & suites d tennis courts e a pool f a theatre g two bars h a cinema.

O'NG TOMON: Katta surat D - mavzuli xonalar kollaji: 'The Cadbury's Chocolate Bedroom', 'The Arabian Nights Suite', 'Peter Rabbit' (quyon haykalchalari), 'The Princess Suite'.
• To'q sariq 'Reading'.
4) a) 'Read the article about the Alton Towers Hotel and explain the words in bold.' b) 'What themed rooms and suites are there in the hotel?'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '82'.

exercises.instructionEn: The Alton Towers Hotel is a famous hotel in England. Look at the pictures. Which shows: a flying machine; a reception desk made of piles of antique luggage; themed rooms and suites; a luxurious restaurant?
exercises.instructionUz: Alton Towers mehmonxonasi - Angliyadagi mashhur mehmonxona. Suratlarga qarang. Qaysi biri ko'rsatadi: uchuvchi mashina; eski jomadonlar uyumidan yasalgan qabulxona stoli; mavzuli xonalar va lyuks xonalar; hashamatli restoran?
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  A - qabulxona: eski jomadonlar
      uyumidan yasalgan stol
  B - hashamatli restoran kirishi
  C - shiftgacha cho'zilgan uchuvchi
      mashina
  D - mavzuli xonalar (Cadbury's
      Chocolate Bedroom, Arabian
      Nights Suite, Peter Rabbit,
      Princess Suite)


⚠ 'A RECEPTION DESK':

  = qabulxona stoli.
  ⚠ 'reception' = qabulxona.


⚠ 'A PILE':

  = uyum, taxlam.
  ⚠ 'piles of luggage' = jomadonlar
  uyumi.


⚠ 'ANTIQUE':

  = qadimiy, antiqa. /ænˈtiːk/.


⚠ 'LUGGAGE':

  = yuk, jomadonlar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN! 'a piece of
  luggage'.


⚠ 'THEMED':

  = mavzuli.
  ⚠ 'theme' = mavzu. /θiːm/.


⚠ 'A SUITE':

  = lyuks xona (bir nechta xonali).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /swiːt/ - 'sweet' kabi!


⚠ 'LUXURIOUS':

  = hashamatli. /lʌɡˈʒʊəriəs/.
  ⚠ 'luxury' = hashamat.

pairs.left: a reception desk made of piles of antique luggage
pairs.leftUz: eski jomadonlar uyumidan yasalgan qabulxona stoli

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Chocolate Bedroom, Arabian Nights Suite, Princess Suite.

exercises.explanationUz:
MEHMONXONA LUG'ATI:

  1 a GUEST = mehmon (mehmonxonada
    yashayotgan) → b
  2 to BOOK = bron qilmoq, band
    qilmoq (= reserve) → b
  3 BABY-LISTENING FACILITY =
    chaqaloq boshqa xonada uxlaganda
    uni eshitib turish qurilmasi → a


⚠ 'A GUEST':

  = mehmon.
  ⚠ /ɡest/ - 'u' o'qilmaydi.


⚠ 'TO BOOK':

  = bron qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'book' (ot) = kitob; (fe'l) =
  bron qilmoq!
  = 'to reserve'.


⚠ 'A FACILITY':

  = qulaylik, xizmat, jihoz.
  ⚠ Ko'plik 'facilities' - ko'p
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'TO LOOK AFTER':

  = qaramoq, parvarish qilmoq.
